steps.instruction: Press CALIBRATE on the SAFETY panel.
steps.hint: Look straight ahead, then press CALIBRATE. Calibration centres your view so every control is within reach.
It is the grey panel on your left, labelled POWER. It shows each power bus, a line feeding power to a group of systems.
Press ACK under the flashing CAUTION light. Acknowledging confirms you have seen the alarm; it does not fix the fault.
Select the CHECKLIST tab on the display above the panel. The checklist lists every step, so nothing is missed.
The caution message names the faulted bus. Select the bus whose FAULT light is lit.
Turn the BUS B selector until it points at ISOLATE. Isolating disconnects the faulted bus so the fault cannot spread.
Push the CROSS-TIE breaker in until it clicks. The cross-tie lets healthy Bus A feed the systems on Bus B.

steps.instruction: Press REPORT when the STATUS display shows RESTORED.
steps.hint: Check that the STATUS display reads RESTORED first. REPORT is on the COMMS (communications) panel; it tells mission control the fault is cleared.
